versions.changelog:
Video prompting skill for popular AI models – comprehensive guide to structure, vocabulary, and platform adaptation.

- Provides in-depth breakdown of high-quality video prompt components with detailed explanations and example phrases.
- Includes extensive vocabularies for camera movement, shot types, lighting, atmosphere, and visual styles in both English and Chinese.
- Offers ready-to-use prompt templates for filmic, scene-establishing, character, action, artistic, and UGC-style videos.
- Lists platform-specific recommendations and usage tips for major AI video models (Sora, Runway, Kling, Seedance, Veo, Hailuo, Pika).
- Shares advanced techniques for describing motion, dynamics, and narrative time flow in prompts.
